members.title: Access
members.noWorkspaceHint: Pick a workspace first, then you can see who has access to it.
members.unclaimed: Nobody has claimed access to this workspace yet, so everything is currently open. Whoever invites someone first becomes the owner.
members.notAMember: You are not part of this workspace. You can read, but not change anything.

list.aria: People with access to this workspace

kindHint.agent: An agent gets a seat of its own: its writes wait as proposals until you approve them, and every call is on record.

members.invited: Invite prepared. TILL sends no mail: hand the code or link over yourself.
members.reinvited: Invitation renewed: the old code has expired, only the new one works. TILL sends no e-mail: pass the code or link on yourself.

goOnline.notice: Invitations need a TILL instance that is reachable online (your own server or managed): locally there is no second sign-in.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke access?
revokeConfirm.body: {name} loses access to this client from the next request on. A new invitation restores it.

members.roleChanged: Role changed. It applies from their next call.
members.emptyHint: Invite a bookkeeper or your Treuhänder, and you share these books.
members.emptyHintLocal: Only this install keeps these books. A second person needs an instance reachable online; the notice by the invite form shows the way.
members.agentIsOwner: The MCP agent is seated as an owner, so it may do anything. Whoever reaches the MCP socket has the same rights. Give it a narrower role below once you know what it should do.

error.generic: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
error.permission_denied: You do not have the right for this action. Nothing was changed.
error.permissionNamed: This needs the "{capability}" right. Nothing was changed.
error.last_owner: This is the only owner. Make somebody else an owner first, or nobody can reach these books.
error.already_member: This person already has access to this workspace.
error.unknown_role: That role does not exist here.
error.unknown_capability: "{capability}" is not a right TILL knows. A role can only recombine rights that already exist.
error.builtin_fixed: Owner and Read only are fixed. They cannot be changed and cannot be archived.
error.role_in_use: Somebody still holds this role. Move them to another role first.
error.member_not_found: This person is no longer part of this workspace.
error.invite_expired: This invite has expired. Invite the person again.
error.invite_not_found: TILL does not know that invite code.
error.actor_already_bound: This session already belongs to somebody else. Accept the invite from the session it was meant for.
error.actor_already_member: This session already has access here. Change its role in the list instead of inviting it.
error.member_kind_mismatch: TILL already knows this address as something else (a person or an agent). The kind belongs to the identity and cannot be changed by an invitation.

Members.title: Access
Members.body: Who may open these books and what each role allows. The members tab lists everyone with access and their role; here you invite people, change roles and revoke access. The roles tab describes which rights sit behind a role. While nobody has been invited, the workspace is open; with the first invite the inviting person takes the owner role.
